x: The weather in no way affected the times and although John Webb won in 50.57 Trowbridge's latest find John Kirk caused quite a sensation with his second place in 51.06.

John Kirk, a new find, moved straight into a lead which he increased by six minutes. Dave, Carl and Delaney of the Vidarians grouped further back and although walking together for much of the race Dave fought clear over the closing stages leaving Carl who although losing one place hung on grimly to his sixth position.
